drills.exercise_question: Which links in the room-air-conditioner channel and component system are observable, and which alternative can still explain the same facts?
learner_tasks: Draw the state-to-driver-to-operating chain without naming a winner.
State the strongest H-B fact that would keep the mechanism unresolved.
Request one next source-bound observation rather than a result or price.
prohibited_substitutes: Do not treat operating cash as owner cash.
Do not treat industry demand as proof of a durable company mechanism.

drills.exercise_question: Can channel simplification and order-supply coordination be separated from category-cycle and acquisition-boundary explanations?
learner_tasks: Map the operational friction the disclosed system could remove.
Write the strongest non-nested rival explanation.
Name the next same-boundary field needed before any cash conclusion.
prohibited_substitutes: Do not promote multi-category execution to a causal verdict.
Do not combine acquisition cash with home-appliance owner cash.

drills.exercise_question: What would distinguish a service-and-logistics delivery mechanism from product-cycle, global-brand and consolidation effects?
learner_tasks: Separate the observed delivery-system facts from customer conversion.
Describe the fact pattern that would favor H-B without using later outcomes.
Record the responsibility-boundary limitation on cash interpretation.
prohibited_substitutes: Do not use global acquisition effects as evidence of domestic appliance owner cash.
Do not rank the company against other issuers.

drills.exercise_question: Do product commonality, cost work and inventory turnover describe a company mechanism, or can weather and category-cycle context explain the same facts?
learner_tasks: Make the weather-and-cycle rival concrete rather than generic.
Specify the missing evidence needed to discuss durable customer acceptance.
prohibited_substitutes: Do not convert annual-report market references into a customer-outcome conclusion.
Do not substitute group cash for a distributable-cash claim.

drills.exercise_question: Can product upgrades, channel adjustment and organisation change be separated from a multi-product issuer mix and category-cycle explanation?
learner_tasks: Map the white-goods mechanism without borrowing facts from unrelated businesses.
State why H-B remains live at the listed-issuer boundary.
Request a product-boundary observation that would reduce the ambiguity.
prohibited_substitutes: Do not use group cash or asset disposals as proof of white-goods economics.
Do not construct a homogeneous causal panel from the five issuers.
